name: tule
description: An engineering computer for your AI agent: CAD with OpenCascade, simulation and 3D-print plates on cloud machines, with a live 3D viewer.

capabilities: Show models in a live 3D viewer
defaultPrompt: Make me a 3D-printable wall hook for a road bike.
Show my Tule projects and what each one has built.
Start a 4-core machine for my bracket project.

positive.prompt: What Tule projects do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's projects with machine state and viewer links, or says there are none yet for a new account.

positive.prompt: Create a Tule project called hook.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the project 'hook' and returns its viewer link.

positive.prompt: Start a machine for my hook project.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a cpu-1 machine for 'hook', waits until /workspace is ready and reports it running.

positive.prompt: How do I model a part with Tule?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the guide index, then the modeling topic, and explains Tule's modeling workflow.

positive.prompt: Stop hook's machine, then delete the hook project.
positive.expected_behavior: Stops hook's machine (autosaving it), then deletes the project 'hook', which the user asked for explicitly.

negative.description: Unit conversion needs no engineering computer

review.commerce_description: Tule sells nothing and processes no payments. GPU machines run on the user's own RunPod account and RunPod bills them directly.

publication.release_notes: First release: projects, machines (Tule cloud CPUs, the user's RunPod GPUs or own computers), outputs with viewer links, autosaves and keys.
